test_title: PYST 14: Selection Post (GraduatiOn Level) - English (Held On 26 Jun, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.

The question is being answered by Sherry.

options.text: The question was answered by Sherry.
The question was being answered by Sherry.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: **The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.**
 
• The given passive voice sentence is: **"The question is being answered by Sherry."**
 
• In the active voice, the focus is on who is performing the action. Hence it becomes: **"Sherry is answering the question."**
 
• The tense remains the same when converting from passive to active voice. Here, it is present continuous.
 
• Thus, the correct active voice sentence is: **"Sherry is answering the question."**

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Sherry is answering the question."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** "Sherry answered the question." – This changes the tense to past simple, which is incorrect.
 
• **Option 3:** "The question was answered by Sherry." – This is in passive voice and changes the tense to past simple.
 
• **Option 4:** "The question was being answered by Sherry." – This retains the passive voice and shifts to past continuous tense.
